title: Cambridge IELTS 12 Test 8 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
scenario: The diagram below shows how geothermal energy is used to produce electricity.

visualData.title: Geothermal power plant
labels: powered by turbine and produces electricity
notes: Cold water is pumped down through the injection well.
Hot water is pumped up through the production well.
The turbine powers the generator, which produces electricity.
